title: feat(spec)!: marketplace:installed-list is retired — refused by name at the schema door; the separate Installed Apps view it drew was retired
body:
Fixes #24230

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Retires the page component type `marketplace:installed-list`, refused by name through `RETIRED_PAGE_COMPONENT_TYPES`. This executes ruling B on #23892 (record `6216295104`, item 2: "the separate Installed Apps view retires once the filtered view serves its actions"), within triage grade `6243387750` and release `6245014494`. objectstack-ai/objectui#12926 (merged `35244b6379`) deleted the type's one renderer. Its one producer, `@objectstack/cloud-connection`'s `marketplace_installed` page, had already left `MARKETPLACE_INSTALLED_UI_BUNDLE` (#23933). The shape follows the `record:json` retirement (PR #24170, `030a7b83e`) surface for surface, with the differences listed below.

Dev session: `session_01SovhHbD8dAQGDyEGHRoSUx` (cloud dispatch from the `domain:spec#1` seat, claim `6245064045`).

## Accept set, before → after, at each door

| door | before (`cbfa5e4335`) | after (this head) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PageComponentSchema.type` (node) | accepts `{ type: 'marketplace:installed-list' }` through the open string arm | refuses: `code: 'custom'`, `path: ['type']`, `params.retiredComponentType: 'marketplace:installed-list'`, message = the prescription. Bare, `{}`-bag and keyed alike |
| `PageSchema` (what `os validate` and save parse) | accepts the node | refuses at `regions[i].components[j].type`, one issue per node |
| `ComponentPropsMap['marketplace:installed-list']` (props gate, `check-yaml-examples`, vocabulary) | strict empty `emptyProps(...)`: `{}` passes, any key refused | row kept as `retiredComponentProps(...)` (`z.never`): every bag refused, `{}` included, `invalid_type` at `[]` with the prescription |
| lint `component-type-unknown` | silent (open-arm plugin namespace) | `error` at `…type`; message = the prescription's head, hint = its "Delete the …" sentence (193 chars, under the one-line 200 cap) |
| lint `component-props-*` | `component-props-unknown-key` on a keyed bag, silent on `{}` | `component-props-invalid` `error` at `…properties` for every bag |
| typo suggester | candidate | no longer a candidate (out of `KNOWN_COMPONENT_TYPE_CANDIDATES`, derived from the map) |
| print pages | `PRINT_REFUSED_PAGE_COMPONENT_TYPES` row | row removed: a retired type is refused at the parse before any print rule reads it (the map's own docblock rule) |
| `PageComponentType` enum | never a member | unchanged: nothing to remove |
| exports | none of its own (`emptyProps` mints no def) | unchanged |

The open string arm stays open, the `marketplace:` namespace included (`marketplace:installed-list-v2` still parses; pinned). Everything else is byte-identical.

The prescription is one string at all doors. Its fix sentence names the route the console uses: "Delete the `marketplace:installed-list` component node; to link to that view, add a `component` navigation item with `componentRef: 'developer:packages'` and `params: { source: 'marketplace' }`." That is the spelling `MARKETPLACE_INSTALLED_UI_BUNDLE`'s own "Installed Apps" entry uses, and it validates against `app.zod.ts`'s `component` navigation item. It carries no tracker number (`check:doc-authoring`).

## Where this differs from the `record:json` precedent

| surface | `record:json` | here |
| --- | --- | --- |
| enum value | removed from `PageComponentType` | n/a, never a member. The map entry is therefore the only parse door. Without it, the retired name would fall back to the open arm and parse in silence (pinned) |
| row | `retiredComponentProps` | same, and here the kept row is the only thing that keeps the name KNOWN (pinned in `component-type-vocabulary.test.ts`) |
| props def / `retired-defs` entry | `RecordJsonProps` deleted, `retired-defs/18.ui__RecordJsonProps.ts` | none: `emptyProps` exports nothing, so no def leaves the published set (H4 measured: `check:generated` moved only `content/docs/references/ui/page.mdx`) |
| D3 entry and step-18 fragment | `ui-record-json-retired` | `ui-marketplace-installed-list-retired`, inserted at its sorted id, `order: 102` (max 101 + 1) |
| sibling D3 entries | none | `ui-cloud-connection-widgets-unknown-keys-refused` amended, `ui-mcp-connect-agent-unknown-keys-refused` one clause (decision below) |
| whole-bag census | `component-record-related-list-parent-23134.test.ts` gained `record:json` | gains `marketplace:installed-list` |
| lint pins | `validate-record-json-23745.test.ts` flipped | `validate-component-types.test.ts`: the accept row is removed (the map-driven `flags %s` case now covers it); `validate-component-props.test.ts`: the keyed-bag and `{}` cases flipped into one whole-bag refusal pin |
| tree-scoped absence walk | new, in `vitest.repo-tests.json` | same, in the new pin file, registered in `vitest.repo-tests.json` |
| `Clause-②` | `no (narrowing)` (shipped in one prerelease only) | `no (narrowing)` too: the type shipped in stable 17.3.0, which decides the ADR-0087 disposition and the FROM → TO text, not the value. The diff widens nothing, and `yes (narrowing)` would claim a widening (contract review `6245719006` ②) |

## The two `semantic/18.*` entries: amended, not superseded

Measured: both entries are in the same major-18 step as the new retirement entry, so an upgrader replaying 17 → 18 reads all three. `ui-cloud-connection-widgets-unknown-keys-refused`'s `acceptanceCriteria` said "Every `cloud-connection:panel` / `marketplace:installed-list` node authors an empty bag and validates clean". After this PR that sentence is false for the second type, and it contradicts the retirement entry. Its id is referenced by shipped CHANGELOG text and by `packages/cli/test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts`'s guidance census. So the entry is amended in place: id kept, `surface`, `replacement` and `acceptanceCriteria` narrowed to `cloud-connection:panel`, and `reason` names the retired sibling and the new entry. Superseding it (new id, old entry deleted or left stale) would either drop a referenced id or leave contradictory text in one step. `ui-mcp-connect-agent-unknown-keys-refused` only named the row historically, as the precedent for its own row. One clause now says that row was since retired by name. No guidance changes.

## H2 / H3 / stop conditions, measured

- **H1 (premise):** true on `origin/main` `cbfa5e4335` (the dispatch read `af284b05e5`): the row (`component.zod.ts`), the docblocks, the print row (`page.zod.ts`) and the lint accept pins were all present.
- **H2 (producers):** no stored-row producer. The `MARKETPLACE_INSTALLED_UI_BUNDLE` carries no `pages`. Outside the spec and tests, the string survives in CHANGELOGs, `content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx` (release-owned, untouched), `packages/spec/liveness/page.json` (a historical read-point note at an older objectui sha, untouched), a doc comment in `packages/cloud-connection/src/canonical-expression-envelopes.test.ts` (hold-off, untouched) and the CLI fixture below. So no D2 conversion is registered.
- **CLI fixture:** `packages/cli/test/platform-page-i18n-parity.test.ts`'s `SAMPLE_PAGE` does not parse the page (no `PageSchema` read in the file), so it did not fail. It did author a `{ type: 'marketplace:installed-list' }` node inside the new absence walk's radius, so its body block is now `element:divider`. The gate reads only the header copy. 27/27 pass.
- **H3 (Console Pin Gate):** `git grep` at the objectui pin `5e15928b46`: the type appears only as a string registration (`InstalledListWidget.tsx`), a CLI known-types string list, tests, and the parity test's `UNJUDGED_SPEC_BLOCKS` entry. There is no typed read of `ComponentPropsMap['marketplace:installed-list']` in non-test source. The row's KEY is kept, so `keyof typeof ComponentPropsMap` and the parity partition's key set are unchanged. Removing the key cannot break the pinned build because the key is not removed. The parity entry's "EMPTY SPEC SHAPE" text becomes "RETIRED UPSTREAM" in objectui's own pin bump, per the card.

## Ablation (fix committed first, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored by blob)

The subject resolves by relative import (`./page.zod`, `./component.zod`) to `src`, so no `dist` rebuild is involved.

- **Mutation:** the map key renamed to `marketplace:installed-list-ABLATED` (held), and the row turned back into `emptyProps('marketplace:installed-list')`. On-disk counts: 1 and 1.
- **Result:** retirement pin 4 failed / 6 passed (the map, the row, `PageComponentSchema`, `PageSchema`); vocabulary pins 2 failed / 20 passed.
- **Restore:** both files back to their `HEAD` blobs (`9146237b28f7`, `0365abe5e2cf`) by hash, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
